verdict.rationale: Numeral is fully API-driven and so inherently headless: it uses API keys, including TEST keys for non-production use, REST endpoints for products, calculations, transactions and refunds, an authenticated ping health-check endpoint, and an MCP HTTPS endpoint that agents can call with a secret key. All of this supports scripted, unattended automation. However, there is no CLI and no CI-specific guidance, so CI use is only implied by the API design. Missing for 10: an official CLI or SDK for headless runs, documented CI/CD usage patterns such as sandbox test fixtures in pipelines, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
